medicalInflation.note_en: “Medical cost trend” is a consultancy's forecast of the rise in the per-person cost of employer medical plans. privateCosts.title_en: Private hospitals: the same operation can cost very different amounts
privateCosts.intro: 私家醫院會公布常見手術嘅「過往收費統計」。第 50 百分位（P50）即係一半病人嘅總賬單低於呢個數；第 90 百分位（P90）即係九成病人低於呢個數。
privateCosts.intro_en: Private hospitals publish “historical bill statistics” for common procedures. The 50th percentile (P50) means half of patients paid a total bill below this amount; the 90th percentile (P90) means nine in ten paid less.

policy.title: 政府醫療政策：最近有咩新嘢？

items.title: 2026 施政報告：公營醫療
points: 全年醫療費用上限 $10,000，毋須經濟審查；全額醫療費用減免受惠人數由每年少於 1.4 萬人增至逾 25 萬人
醫管局藥物名冊新增 16 種藥物；撒瑪利亞基金新增 53 項藥物及自費醫療裝置
醫管局目標五年內將指定專科穩定新症輪候時間減半，2027-28 年度先減 10%
年底前推出社區藥房計劃，首階段涵蓋東區、油尖旺、元朗、沙田
points_en: Annual medical charges capped at $10,000 with no means test; people receiving full medical fee waivers to rise from under 14,000 a year to over 250,000
16 drugs added to the Hospital Authority Drug Formulary; 53 drugs and self-financed medical devices added to the Samaritan Fund
The Hospital Authority aims to halve waiting times for stable new cases in designated specialties within five years, starting with a 10% cut in 2027-28
A community pharmacy programme to launch by year-end, first covering Eastern, Yau Tsim Mong, Yuen Long and Sha Tin

basics.title: 四種基本保障，各自解決咩問題？
basics.title_en: Four types of basic protection, and what each one covers

items.name: 醫療
items.solves_en: Bills for hospital stays, operations and tests
items.note: 一般按實際開支賠償（有上限）。
items.note_en: Usually reimburses actual costs (up to limits).

items.name: 危疾
items.solves: 確診嚴重疾病後嘅收入損失、康復開支
items.solves_en: Lost income and recovery costs after a serious illness is diagnosed
items.note: 一般係確診後一筆過賠償，用途自己決定。
items.note_en: Usually pays a lump sum on diagnosis, to use as you choose.

items.name: 意外
items.solves: 意外受傷嘅醫療費、傷殘
items.solves_en: Medical costs and disability from accidental injury

items.name: 人壽
items.solves: 萬一離世，屋企人嘅生活費、債務
items.solves_en: Living costs and debts for your family if you die
items.note: 有人靠你收入生活先特別重要。
items.note_en: Especially important if others depend on your income.

tips: 公司醫療好有用，但轉工、失業或者退休時就會冇咗，亦可能有賠償上限。
自願醫保（VHIS）係政府訂立標準嘅個人醫療保險框架；合資格保費可申請稅務扣除，扣除額上限每名受保人每年 $8,000（稅務局，2025/26 課稅年度）。注意：$8,000 係喺應課稅入息入面扣減嘅金額，唔係直接少交 $8,000 稅；實際慳到幾多視乎你嘅稅率，例如邊際稅率 17% 最多慳 $1,360。
睇保障唔係「越多越好」，而係先睇清自己有咩、缺咩、預算幾多。
tips_en: Employer medical cover is useful, but it ends when you change jobs, lose your job or retire, and it may have benefit limits.

The Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) is a government framework of standards for individual medical insurance. Qualifying premiums can be claimed as a tax deduction, capped at $8,000 per insured person per year (Inland Revenue Department, 2025/26 year of assessment). Note: the $8,000 is deducted from your taxable income; it is not $8,000 less tax. What you actually save depends on your tax rate. At a 17% marginal rate, the most you save is $1,360.
More cover isn't always better. Start with what you already have, what's missing and what you can afford.
basics.source: 一般保險知識整理；自願醫保資料請以醫務衞生局及稅務局最新公布為準
basics.source_en: General insurance knowledge; for VHIS details, the latest announcements from the Health Bureau and the Inland Revenue Department prevail
